raw.query: SELECT model, signal, (detail->'15s'->>'cov90')::numeric AS cov90_15s FROM quantile_coverage WHERE model LIKE '%_cov' ORDER BY model, signal;
raw.observed: chronos_cov & toto_cov: cov90 @15s ranges 0.884-0.896; ewma_cal_coverage eval at nominal 0.9 @15s ranges 0.877-0.901
raw.evidence: At 15s resolution, calibrated forecasting models (chronos_cov/toto_cov) across all signals show p90 coverage of 0.884-0.896, and calibrated baseline methods (add, mult, wsc) on the evaluation split have p90 coverage of 0.877-0.901.
